items.quote: And people are from outside looking in real estate, they think, well, it's just such an easy thing. I can do that. I like properties.
items.statement: People believe real estate is an easy field to enter just because they like properties.

items.quote: Can you please save my number? Whatever you need to buy or sell, please call me.
items.statement: Real estate agents often ask potential clients to save their contact information for future deals.

items.quote: How many of those are actually calling you back?
items.statement: Most potential clients do not respond or call back after being contacted by real estate agents.

items.quote: We value what we own, what is us, what we we have, is way more than something that we don't own yet.
items.statement: People typically value their own property significantly more than properties they do not own.

overview: This source chunk contains insights about common misconceptions in real estate and client engagement strategies from a video transcript.
